Very good game, not for everyone obviously like most games but it is fun, relaxing, fun on your own and with friends. A lot of content on its own and even more with the workshop posts. Already pretty cheap and goes on sale often. One of my favourites, loads of bosses and love the difficulty options. Journey mode is good for a world where you want to build a lot and don't want to grind resources and blocks. Lots of depth for a 2D game and the visuals are very nice and appealing. Could absolutely go on way longer saying everything positive but half of the people seeing this review most likely haven't even read half of it. Would recommend awesome game.
